Notice of PHAOA GBM - 7th April 2024

Dear Members,

Notice is hereby given to all members that the 1st General Body
Meeting of Panchsheel Hynish Apartment Owners Association 2024-25
will be held on Sunday, 7 th April 2024 at 7:00PM at the Hynish
Badminton Court.

Agenda –
1. Introduction of newly elected board members.
2. Updates on handover from former AOA.
3. Updates on handover from EC.
4. Updates on meeting and follow-up in last 3 weeks.
5. Road map/plan of handover of services from Builder.
6. Open house & feedbacks.
7. Vote of Thanks

On behalf of Board of management
Anjali Negi
